messages:
Maria: Heads-up — compiling final customer-facing commitments doc for GA. Need confirm on SLA wording and billing phrasing.
Alex: Thanks. Can we lock availability SLO and incident window? We promised 99.9% but need oncall coverage plan.
Maria: Right now we have 99.9% standard for Dedicated; hosted default is 99.5. Which do we want in marketing?
Jamal: For pilot customers we said 'enterprise SLA available' — we should avoid stating 99.9 for hosted until Dedicated GA.
Sophia: Docs: we need an explicit 'what's included' list for support tiers. Also a rollback/cutover section.
Kevin: On pricing phrasing — don't promise per-token discounts until finops signs off. Use 'usage-based pricing with enterprise commitments available'.
Maria: Agreement: public marketing will say 'SLA options for Dedicated and Enterprise customers; contact sales for details.' Internal runbook will list exact SLOs.
Alex: Oncall: who owns paging for model regressions vs infra? Proposal: Eng-ML owns model quality alerts; Eng-SRE owns infra/latency pages.
Jamal: +1. Need a brief playbook in runbooks/ops:

```
- Alert: high-latency 95th > 250ms for 3m -> page eng-sre
- Alert: model-quality drift -> page eng-ml
- Fallback: route to smaller model variant
- Customer notification: PM -> account team
```

Sophia: We'll add that snippet to docs and include runbook links.
Kevin: Billing: we should include 'trial credits' language and overage policy. Also note that dedicated commitments have monthly minimums.
Maria: Who's writing the final customer-facing FAQ? Need it by EOD Thursday.
Alex: I can draft the SLA blurb. Jamal can own oncall/responsibilities. Sophia will draft support tier table.
Jamal: I'll also add escalation matrix.
Maria: Action items then:
- Alex: draft SLA blurb and share for legal
- Sophia: support tier table + FAQ draft
- Jamal: runbook snippet + escalation matrix
- Kevin: finalize pricing language with finops

Please drop updates here. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC (no customer impact expected)
Kevin: Noted the deploy window.
Alex: Shared SLA blurb in doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ga-sla-draft
Sophia: Uploaded support table draft to the doc.
Jamal: Runbook snippet pushed to repo — PR#342
Maria: Great, if we get these by EOD Thursday we can lock public comms next week.
Kevin: One more thing — legal asked to avoid the word 'guarantee' in marketing.
Maria: Got it. Use 'commitment' or 'target' instead.
Alex: Will replace 'guarantee' with 'commitment' in the draft.
Sophia: Anything else? Customer asks about data residency for EU customers — do we commit to region routing?
Jamal: We have region routing for Dedicated; hosted will have EU region by GA but we shouldn't promise latency or residency guarantees for hosted until validated.
Maria: Add this to FAQ as 'EU region available for Dedicated; hosted regional availability coming soon — contact sales for compliance needs.'
Kevin: Ok, all aligned. Thanks team.
